column1: Field office, storage and laydown areas:
Are there any Laydown/storage areas, which have been designated by the client for this purpose? (Mark on plot plan to show laydown/storage areas).
Are these areas accessible by trucks, cranes, forklifts, etc.?
Are there any restricted or congested road/areas? (If so describe)
Are any additional roadways, or gates needed to accommodate emergency vehicles Medical/Fire truck etc. or construction activities?
Adequate parking facilities for employees, contractors, and visitors?
Any special requirements for temporary buildings with respect to location/size, materials of construction, and etc.?
Will camps be needed? ( If yes, for how many workers and who will provide)?
Eating facilities- will mess facilities need to be provided? (If yes describe)?
Will there be any need to provide transportation from parking areas, or living quarters to the job site?
